name: True Markets API
description:
Every public True Markets REST API in one document. Each is also published on its own:

- [Authentication REST spec](https://docs.truemarkets.co/openapi/auth.yaml): Exchange an API key signature for a token, and refresh it.
- [Accounts REST spec](https://docs.truemarkets.co/openapi/account.yaml): Create the users your organization trades for, with their wallets, and read deposit details.
- [Trading REST spec](https://docs.truemarkets.co/openapi/gateway.yaml): Quotes, orders, transfers, balances and transactions, for your own account or for a user you act for.
- [CeFi direct REST spec](https://docs.truemarkets.co/openapi/cefi-direct.yaml): Order entry, balances and market data on the CeFi venue, for firms with direct access.
- [Market data REST spec](https://docs.truemarkets.co/openapi/marketdata.yaml): Prices, candles and history across venues, without a token.
